notes: Li et al 2021 Front Microbiol, Edwardsiella piscicida (uses PPD130/91 and EIB202-context genome). Quote 'we have demonstrated that EvpQ is a T6SS effector that is translocated into eukaryotic host cells.' found verbatim in PMC full text. Paper shows EvpQ secreted in T6SS-dependent manner (anti-HA supernatant blot, T6SS-deficient mutant) and translocated into host cells via CyaA reporter. Strict secretion documented. Organism matches row (E. piscicida EIB202).

Sana et al 2016 PNAS, S. Typhimurium 14028s (matches row strain 14028). DOI resolves, organism matches. Quote 'this activity is mediated by the specific interaction of Hcp1 with the antibacterial amidase Tae4' is verbatim in abstract BUT documents Hcp1 function/Hcp1-Tae4 interaction, NOT Tae4 secretion or translocation. Abstract (full text not accessible, isOpenAccess=N via EuropePMC) presents Hcp1 secretion, not a Tae4 supernatant/translocation assay. Under STRICT rubric the quote does not document Tae4 export; Tae4-as-substrate rests on its being a known amidase effector. No accessible verbatim Tae4-secretion sentence to propose as fix_quote. NOTE accession mismatch: UniProt A0A0F6AX88 = STM14_0334, annotated 'Cytoplasmic protein' with TagF domain (PF09867, a T6SS post-translational regulator), not the Tae4 amidase effector. Flag for human review.

Flaugnatti et al 2016 Mol Microbiol, enteroaggregative E. coli Sci-1 (row organism E. coli 042 = EAEC 042, matches). DOI resolves. Quote 'We further identify Tle1, a toxin effector encoded by this cluster and showed that Tle1 possesses phospholipase A1 and A2 activities required for the interbacterial competition.' verbatim in abstract. Paper documents Tle1 is T6SS-delivered into periplasm of prey cells via VgrG1 spike (T6SS-machinery-dependent translocation). Strict secretion documented.

English et al 2012 Mol Microbiol, Serratia marcescens Db10 (matches row organism). DOI resolves. Quote 'Ssp1 and Ssp2 were shown to be secreted substrates of the T6SS by immunoblotting secreted fractions from the wild type strain, two T6SS mutants' found verbatim in PMC full text (Results, 'Ssp1 and Ssp2 are Type VI-secreted effectors'); cited fragment ends mid-sentence but span is exact. Documents secretion via anti-Ssp1/Ssp2 immunoblot of secreted fractions, T6SS-dependent. Row uniprot '-' echoed verbatim.
